title: Match teammate names phonetically against the roster and warn on confusable bot names
description: Names are the wake word, and Tiny misheard 'Grace' as 'grays' 2 of 10 even with key terms. Match addressed names phonetically against the org roster only, and warn when a new bot's name sounds like an existing one. See docs/VOICE.md, Spike results > Test 4, and Design > 2.
